content.text:
The migration of all four service modules is done, and the full test suite passes (10/10). But the API routes are now broken, and in more places than the dispatcher reported. Nothing has been committed.

**What was migrated:** `user-service.js`, `order-service.js`, `payment-service.js` and `auth-service.js` in `src/services/` now go through repository classes and return promises instead of taking callbacks. Their tests were updated to match. A new `src/repositories/payment-repository.js` was added. The user-service worker failed once on an API error before making any changes; the dispatcher retried it and the retry succeeded.

**Problem in the routes:** the dispatcher said only `src/api/routes.js:10` (the `listOrdersForUser` route) still passes a callback. In fact all five handlers in `src/api/routes.js:8-12` do. `listActiveUsers`, `findUser`, `listOrdersForUser`, `totalPaidCents` and `uncapturedTotalCents` all now ignore the `cb` argument, so every one of those endpoints will hang without responding. The tests don't cover the routes, which is why they still pass.

**Leftover files:** there's an untracked `.agent-work/migration` directory left behind by the agents. You'll probably want to delete it or add it to `.gitignore` before committing.

Should I update the five route handlers to use the promise-returning functions (e.g. `.then((r) => cb(null, r), cb)`) and remove `.agent-work/`?
